description: A single appended, hash-chained state-change record. The JSONL session log is the source of truth; hash = sha256 of canonical JSON of {seq, ts, type, payload_sha256, prev_hash}.

hash.description: Chain hash over {seq, ts, type, payload_sha256, prev_hash}.

payload.description: Event body; schema depends on type.

payload_sha256.description: sha256 of canonical JSON of payload.

prev_hash.description: Previous event hash; 64 zeros for seq 1.
